Title: Foundation (Identity + Accounts + Ledger)
Description: Phase A. The substrate every other capability stands on. Ledger is source of truth for all balances; identity resolves any registered identifier to canonical user_id; accounts hold money or points per user per tenant.

Title: User registration with multi-identifier support
Description: POST /api/v1/identity/users with one or more tenant-scoped identifiers. Duplicate identifier in same tenant -> 409 identifier_already_in_use. Same identifier across different tenants allowed. PRD: Pay-PRD-0010, 0050, 0070

Title: Identifier resolution endpoint
Description: GET /api/v1/identity/resolve/{type}/{value}?tenant_id=... returns user_id. Cross-tenant lookup returns 404 (no leak). PRD: Pay-PRD-0060. NFR: 0220

Title: Account model with 5 types
Description: financial_wallet, points_account, system_points_issuance, provider_redemption_wallet, system_cash_inflow. POST /accounts, GET /{id}/balance. PRD: Pay-PRD-0110-0140

Title: Internal ledger service with double-entry invariants
Description: All writes through post_transaction. >=2 entries balanced to zero. Idempotency keyed per tenant. PRD: Pay-PRD-0170, 0180, 0200. NFR: 0100

Title: Append-only ledger structural guarantee
Description: ledger_entries has no updated_at column. Invariant test asserts column does not exist. System-wide sum-to-zero invariant test runs every session. PRD: Pay-PRD-0170. NFR: 0100

Title: Seed script + 2 test users + system_points_issuance
Description: Idempotent seed: Sasai-ZA tenant, Alice/Bob with phones, financial_wallets, points_accounts, master system_points_issuance.

Title: P2P Transfer
Description: Phase B. User-to-user transfer of wallet funds. First feature that moves money between users.

Title: POST /payments/p2p with overdraft prevention
Description: Idempotency-Key header required. Recipient resolved by identifier. Self-transfer -> 422. Insufficient funds -> 409. Balanced two-leg ledger transaction. PRD: Pay-PRD-0250, 0220, 0200, 0060

Title: Concurrent double-spend protection via SELECT FOR UPDATE
Description: Sender wallet row locked during balance derive. Test proves exactly one of two concurrent full-balance transfers succeeds. PRD: Pay-PRD-0220. NFR: 0100

Title: Internal top_up service + opening balances
Description: top_up() debits system_cash_inflow, credits user wallet. Auto-creates system_cash_inflow per (tenant, currency). Seed gives Alice R1000, Bob R500 with per-user idempotency keys.

Title: Kafka Rewards Inflow
Description: Phase C. External Kafka events drive rules evaluation; matching rules credit user points accounts.

Title: External event source registration
Description: POST /events/sources. source_key globally unique. Optional shared_secret for HMAC. PRD: Pay-PRD-0495, 0510

Title: Event ingestion with dedup + tenant scoping
Description: POST /events/external. Unregistered source -> REJECTED log. Duplicate (source_key, event_id) -> DUPLICATE log. Tenant mismatch rejected. PRD: Pay-PRD-0490, 0495, 0500, 0520

Title: Rules engine: first_time + milestone
Description: Two of seven rule types. first_time fires once per user. milestone counts qualifying events, fires at threshold, resets. Source-agnostic. PRD: Pay-PRD-0530-0617, 0570, 0580

Title: Reward issuance with double-issuance protection
Description: Writes reward_events row + balanced ledger transaction. UNIQUE INDEX on (user_id, rule_id, triggering_event_id) is structural guarantee. Relies on integrity error, no check-then-insert. PRD: Pay-PRD-0620. NFR: 0110

Title: Rule CRUD admin endpoints
Description: POST /rules with rule_type-specific validation. GET /rules tenant-scoped. PRD: Pay-PRD-0530-0617 CRUD slice

Title: Redemption + Catalog
Description: Phase D. User converts earned points into cash via a registered redemption provider. Catalog endpoints surface user's full rewards story.

Title: Redemption provider registration
Description: POST /redemption/providers creates provider + provider_redemption_wallet atomically. redemption_wallet_account_id FK populated. PRD: Pay-PRD-0730

Title: Initiate redemption (two-legged PENDING)
Description: POST /redemption/initiate with Idempotency-Key. Lock user.points_account, derive_balance, reject if insufficient. Atomic two-leg PENDING. Concurrent double-spend blocked. PRD: Pay-PRD-0660, 0670, 0740

Title: Confirm redemption (PENDING -> COMPLETED)
Description: POST /redemption/{id}/confirm flips entries PENDING -> COMPLETED. Re-confirming -> 409. PRD: Pay-PRD-0690

Title: Fail redemption (PENDING -> REVERSED)
Description: POST /redemption/{id}/fail flips PENDING -> REVERSED, restoring points. Reason required. PRD: Pay-PRD-0700

Title: Catalog summary endpoint
Description: GET /catalog/{user_id}/summary returns available + reserved + lifetime_earned + lifetime_redeemed. No points_account -> points: null. PRD: Pay-PRD-0970

Title: Redemption history endpoint
Description: GET /catalog/{user_id}/redemption-history newest first, tenant-scoped. PRD: Pay-PRD-1030

Title: Points history endpoint (full audit trail)
Description: GET /catalog/{user_id}/points-history per-entry ledger view with rule_name + triggering_event_id for reward credits. PRD: Pay-PRD-0980

Title: Reconciliation + Admin UI
Description: Phase E. Closes redemption's stale PENDING gap. E.1 = backend reconciliation; E.2 = admin UI shell; E.3 = admin pages.

Title: Sweep stale PENDING redemptions (Phase E.1)
Description: POST /reconciliation/sweep with threshold_minutes. Bumps retry_count. Escalates to MANUAL_REVIEW after provider.max_retries. Audit log per item. Ignores COMPLETED. PRD: Pay-PRD-0750, 0790, 0800

Title: Manual resolve from MANUAL_REVIEW (Phase E.1)
Description: POST /reconciliation/{id}/resolve with outcome (COMPLETED/REVERSED) and reason. Flips ledger entries. Rejects non-MANUAL_REVIEW. Cross-tenant 404. Audit_log written. PRD: Pay-PRD-0780, 0790

Title: Audit log query (Phase E.1)
Description: GET /reconciliation/audit tenant-scoped with optional entity_type/entity_id filters. Newest first. Hard cap on limit. PRD: Pay-PRD-0800. NFR: 0160, 0250

Title: Provider status-check polling (Phase E.1+)
Description: Sweep calls provider status_check_url for each PENDING. TLS 1.2+ enforced. HMAC-verified response (Phase F pairing). PRD: Pay-PRD-0720. Depends on Phase F.

Title: Scheduled sweep via Celery beat (Phase E.1+)
Description: Celery beat every 15 min. Configurable per tenant. Emits pending_count metrics. PRD: Pay-PRD-0750. NFR: 0070

Title: Admin UI shell (Phase E.2)
Description: Next.js 16 AppShell: sidebar, topbar, command palette ⌘K, Keycloak login, tenant switcher. Dark mode default. Per docs/04-ui-layouts.md §3-4. Depends on Phase F.

Title: Admin pages: Users, Transactions, Reconciliation, Audit (Phase E.3)
Description: Four operator screens with drawers, status pills, JSON diff viewer for audit. Per docs/04-ui-layouts.md §5. Depends on Story 5.6.

Title: Authentication & Roles
Description: Phase F. Keycloak JWT validation on admin endpoints; PIN/OTP flow for end users; HMAC verification on provider callbacks; Module 7 Roles & Permissions.

Title: Keycloak JWT validation dependency (Phase F.1)
Description: get_current_admin() validates Keycloak JWT signature + exp + iss. require_admin_role(role) is the per-endpoint gate. Applied to all reconciliation endpoints as the pilot. 19 new auth tests + 32 existing reconciliation tests pre-authed. 110/110 tests pass. PRD: Pay-PRD-0100. NFR: 0170, 0180, 0210, 0260

Title: PIN/OTP user authentication flow
Description: Module 1 user-side: register -> OTP verify -> PIN set -> PIN auth. bcrypt hashes. Lockout after PIN_MAX_ATTEMPTS. Session tokens in Redis only. PRD: Pay-PRD-0020-0040. NFR: 0170, 0180, 0190

Title: Per-user Roles & Permissions (Module 7)
Description: roles, role_permissions, user_roles tables. Role check is first step in payment orchestration. PRD: Pay-PRD-0440-0470, Pay-PRD-0260 step 1

Title: Remove test-only body params (sender_user_id, tenant_id)
Description: Every endpoint resolves actor from token. OpenAPI tags lose test-only suffix. Tests pass JWT in Authorization header.

Title: HMAC verification on provider callbacks
Description: Provider webhook signatures via shared_secret. HMAC-SHA256 with constant-time comparison. Timestamp tolerance <= 5min. PRD: Pay-PRD-0495. NFR: 0210, 0260

Title: Audit log writes from every state-changing endpoint
Description: Wire audit_log into payments, redemption, rules, etc. Every config change recorded. Every status transition recorded. NFR: 0160, 0250

Title: Money Controls (Budgets + Limits + Pricing)
Description: Phase G. Pre-issuance guards: platform-side budget caps, per-tenant transaction limits, transaction fees.

Title: Reward budgets table + pre-issuance check
Description: reward_budgets table with scope_type, scope_id, currency, window_type. check_budget_available() called inside issue_points_reward. Budget exceeded -> 409. 50/80/100% alert hooks.

Title: Module 5: Limits & Thresholds
Description: limit_configs per tenant + transaction_type. Min/max per-transaction. Daily count + value caps. Step 2 of Pay-PRD-0260. PRD: Pay-PRD-0330-0380

Title: Module 6: Pricing Engine
Description: Fixed + variable fees per transaction type. Fee calculated before ledger write. Fee added as debit leg. Zero-fee still checks. Step 3 of Pay-PRD-0260. PRD: Pay-PRD-0390-0430

Title: Admin UI for limits + pricing config
Description: Per-tenant editable tables. Inline edit. Audit log on save. Per docs/04-ui-layouts.md §5.6.

Title: Notifications & Engagement
Description: Module 13 + Module 17. Internal SMS/push; outbound events to WebEngage.

Title: Transaction completion notification
Description: SMS/push on COMPLETED transaction. PRD: Pay-PRD-0810, 0840

Title: Reward issuance notification
Description: SMS/push on reward issuance. PRD: Pay-PRD-0830

Title: WebEngage outbound emitter (reward.issued, tier.changed, streak.broken, milestone.approaching)
Description: Emit external engagement events to wallet.engagement.outbound topic. PRD: Pay-PRD-1060-1120

Title: Catalog Expansion
Description: Module 16 beyond Phase D summary/history.

Title: Tier status + auto-progression
Description: tiers table with thresholds. tier change tracked in user_tier_history. PRD: Pay-PRD-0990

Title: Badges (earned + locked display)
Description: badges + user_badges tables. Auto-award when rule fires. PRD: Pay-PRD-1010

Title: Active challenges
Description: Challenges with deadline + completion criteria. PRD: Pay-PRD-1020

Title: Next milestone nudges
Description: Compute remaining actions per active rule. Used for engagement. PRD: Pay-PRD-1000

Title: Points expiry warnings
Description: Points expiry per Pay-PRD-1040. DEFERRED per PRD §5 non-goal in Phase 1.

Title: Rules Engine Expansion
Description: Remaining 5 of 7 rule types from PRD Module 9.

Title: Streak rule type
Description: Streak rule + streak-broken event emission. PRD: Pay-PRD-0615, 0616

Title: Value-based rule type
Description: Min amount filter on count-based rules. PRD: Pay-PRD-0618

Title: Composite rule type (AND/OR)
Description: rule_conditions table. AND/OR composite logic. PRD: Pay-PRD-0619

Title: Campaign rule type
Description: start_date/end_date bounds. Auto-deactivate on end. PRD: Pay-PRD-0621

Title: Referral rule type
Description: referral_codes + referrals tables. Referring user rewarded on referred user qualifying action. PRD: Pay-PRD-0622

Title: Bonus multipliers
Description: bonus_multipliers + bonus_multiplier_rules tables. Time-limited point boost. PRD: Pay-PRD-0623

Title: Segment binding on rules + segments module
Description: segments + segment_members + segment_upload_history. Behavioural + uploaded segments. Rule audience binding. PRD: Pay-PRD-0624, Module 15 (0910-0960)
